title: stilt.toml
description: A Stilt package's manifest: a TOML 1.0 document with at most two tables, `[package]` and `[dependencies]`. Any other table or key, and a value of another type, are E0600. An empty file is a manifest with no name and no dependencies (packages.manifest).

name.description: The package's name: a valid first segment of a module's name, a lowercase identifier that is neither a keyword, a reserved word nor a primitive type name (program.module-names), other than `main`. A package that another depends on must have one (E0603), and one that only runs needs none (packages.package-table).

dependencies.description: The package's dependencies, each by its name, which must be the name its own manifest gives it (E0603), since there are no import aliases (packages.dependency-names).

dependency.description: A dependency: a `path` to a package developed beside this one, or a git repository it is fetched `from`, with the `version` and the `hash` that every command fills in (packages.dependencies, packages.path-dependencies and packages.filling-in).

path.description: The directory that holds the dependency, relative to the manifest's directory, with `/` as the separator. It must hold a `stilt.toml` (E0601). Only the root package and its path dependencies may have path dependencies (packages.path-dependencies).

from.description: The git repository that holds the dependency: `HOST/PATH`, fetched from `https://HOST/PATH`, whose host may give a port, as `HOST:PORT`, or a `file://` URL of a repository on the machine. Its versions are its tags `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` (packages.dependencies and packages.versions).

version.description: The dependency's version, `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`: three decimal numbers without leading zeros. A command fills it in when it is missing, with the repository's highest version (packages.dependencies and packages.filling-in).

hash.description: The dependency's content hash: `b3:` and 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits, the BLAKE3 digest of its manifest and the `.lt` files under its `src/`. A command fills it in, and content whose hash differs is E0602 (packages.content-hash and packages.checked-content).

may.description: The effects the dependency is granted: `io`, which grants every capability and `io` without one, or one or more of the capabilities below it, which grant those; and `unsafe`, which grants C code. A string listed twice, and `io` listed with a capability, are E0600. With no `may`, it is granted none (packages.grants; facts.capability-grants; c.granting-unsafe).

markdownEnumDescriptions: The console: `print`, `eprint` and the console functions of `std.io`
C code: the `unsafe` blocks of the dependency's own code, which `io` doesn't grant
